verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://supabase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and links a single-file llms-full.txt. Supabase documents an 'API and agent resources' section with per-language reference corpora (js, python, swift, cli, api, etc.), the OpenAPI spec and the MCP endpoint. Agent-oriented docs are also available as .md guide pages, agent skills, curated prompt files and an MCP `search_docs` tool. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and the root docs.md path returns 404.
